title: Coordinate Plane & Graphing
description: Learn to plot points, identify quadrants, and graph equations on the coordinate plane

definition.title: What is the Coordinate Plane?
definition.intro: The coordinate plane is a two-dimensional surface where we can locate points using ordered pairs of numbers. It's like a map with a grid!

axes.title: The Two Axes
axes.xDescription: Runs left and right. Positive numbers go right, negative numbers go left.
axes.yDescription: Runs up and down. Positive numbers go up, negative numbers go down.

point.title: Ordered Pairs
point.description: Every point on the coordinate plane is identified by an ordered pair:
point.example: Example: (3, 2) means 3 units right and 2 units up from the origin

quadrants.title: The Four Quadrants
quadrants.intro: The axes divide the plane into four sections called quadrants, numbered counterclockwise:

plotting.title: How to Plot a Point
plotting.step2: Move horizontally according to the x-coordinate (right if positive, left if negative)
plotting.step3: Move vertically according to the y-coordinate (up if positive, down if negative)
plotting.step4: Mark the point and label it

origin.title: The Origin
origin.description: The point where the x-axis and y-axis intersect. It has coordinates:

example1.title: Example 1: Plotting a Point
example1.step2Text: Move 3 units to the LEFT (because x = -3)
example1.resultText: The point (-3, 4) is in Quadrant II

example2.title: Example 2: Identifying Quadrants
example2.problem: Identify which quadrant each point is in:
example2.pointAAnswer: Both coordinates are positive → Quadrant I
example2.pointBAnswer: Both coordinates are negative → Quadrant III
example2.pointCAnswer: x is positive, y is negative → Quadrant IV

realWorld.title: Real World Applications
realWorld.intro: The coordinate plane is used everywhere in the modern world!

app1.title: 🗺️ Maps & Navigation
app1.description: GPS systems and maps use coordinate systems to show your location and give directions.
app1.example: Your phone uses latitude and longitude (similar to coordinates) to pinpoint your exact location on Earth.
app1.meaning: Every location has unique coordinates, just like every point on the coordinate plane!

app2.title: 🎮 Video Games
app2.description: Game developers use coordinate planes to track character positions and movements.
app2.example: When your character moves in a game, the computer updates their (x, y) coordinates to show their new position on screen.
app2.meaning: Everything you see moving in a video game is based on changing coordinates!

app3.title: 📊 Data Visualization
app3.description: Scientists, economists, and analysts use graphs to visualize data and identify trends.
app3.example: A scatter plot showing the relationship between study time (x-axis) and test scores (y-axis) helps identify patterns.
app3.meaning: Coordinate planes help us see patterns and make predictions from data!

exercises.title: Practice Exercises
exercises.instruction: Try these problems to test your understanding!

exercise1.title: Exercise 1: Identify the Quadrant
exercise1.question: In which quadrant is the point (-7, 5) located?
exercise1.solution: x is negative and y is positive, so the point is in Quadrant II.

exercise2.title: Exercise 2: Plot and Describe
exercise2.question: What are the coordinates of a point that is 4 units left and 3 units down from the origin?
exercise2.solution: 4 units left means x = -4, and 3 units down means y = -3

exercise4.title: Exercise 4: Table of Values
exercise4.question: Create a table of values for y = 2x - 1 using x = 0, 1, 2
exercise4.answer: Plot these three points and connect them to graph the line

tip1.title: 📍 Order Matters!
tip1.text: Always remember: x comes first, then y. Think of it as going through a door - you walk across the floor (x) before going up the stairs (y)!

tip2.title: ✅ Check Your Signs
tip2.text: Pay careful attention to positive and negative signs. A small mistake with signs can put your point in the wrong quadrant!

tip3.title: 📐 Use Graph Paper
tip3.text: When graphing by hand, use graph paper to keep your axes straight and spacing even. This makes plotting points much easier and more accurate.

tip4.title: 🎯 Label Everything
tip4.text: Always label your axes, mark the origin, and label important points. This helps you (and others) understand your graph clearly.

conclusion.title: Summary
conclusion.summary: Excellent work! You've learned how to navigate the coordinate plane, a fundamental skill for advanced math and real-world applications.
conclusion.point1: The coordinate plane uses ordered pairs (x, y) to locate points
conclusion.point2: Four quadrants have different sign combinations for coordinates
conclusion.point3: Distance formula helps find the length between two points
conclusion.point4: Coordinate systems are used in GPS, gaming, graphing, and data visualization
